content.text: Digital creators often face significant barriers when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-solana-payments-digital-6|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-8|Setting Up]] up an online store, especially in countries with restricted access to payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal. With crypto payments gaining traction, you need a robust infrastructure that allows you to bypass these limitations. This guide will show you how to utilize [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-everything-you-need-10|supabase]] as the order database for your digital store, providing a seamless setup that doesn't rely on traditional payment methods. Whether you're in Nigeria, Venezuela, or any region where conventional platforms fail, this guide gives you the tools to get your store live without additional restrictions.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure offered by COREMERCH is designed specifically for creators in regions where platforms like Stripe have failed. By leveraging decentralized solutions, you can maintain full control over your store and transactions. Stack 01’s combination of GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments allows for rapid deployment without the constraints imposed by traditional payment gateways. This setup not only circumvents restrictions but empowers you with the sovereignty over your digital commerce operations. You’re not just building a store; you’re establishing a resilient digital commerce presence that functions independently of flawed systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store, gather the essential tools and resources. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your site, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, priced at $47, which provides complete documentation and source code necessary for deployment. Understanding these components will streamline the process and ensure you’re ready to implement the infrastructure without unnecessary confusion. Prepare your digital products, set up your storage solutions, and ensure you have a clear vision of your store’s layout and functionality.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools and resources ready, focus on establishing your payment and delivery system. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you understand transaction fees and processing times. Next, use Apps Script to create an automated system that verifies payments and delivers your digital products seamlessly. Your order database in Supabase will store customer details and transaction records, allowing for easy management and retrieval of orders. This setup guarantees that once a payment is confirmed, your customers receive their products without delays, establishing trust and reliability in your digital store.
Leverage decentralized solutions for total control over your store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline established, it’s time to go live. Deploy your site on GitHub Pages, ensuring all links and resources are functional. Test your payment processing by conducting a mock transaction using a cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments. Monitor the entire process to ensure the system operates smoothly from payment initiation to product delivery. This step is crucial in identifying any potential issues before you start promoting your store. Once your testing is successful, you’re ready to announce your digital store to the world, confident in your infrastructure’s ability to handle real transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your digital store is live and operational, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Analyze customer behavior and feedback to optimize your offerings and improve user experience. You can expand your product range and explore additional marketing channels to reach a broader audience. Utilizing the resources in the Sovereign Blueprint will aid in scaling your operations while maintaining infrastructure integrity. Remember to keep your backend efficient, and continuously test your payment processing to ensure it handles increased traffic without difficulty. Scaling is not just about adding more products; it's about enhancing your entire customer journey.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by setting up a GitHub account for hosting your site. Use Apps Script to manage your backend logic and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. With this setup, you can create a seamless shopping experience without relying on conventional payment platforms. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for comprehensive guidance on deploying your infrastructure efficiently.
Your infrastructure allows you to operate independently of traditional payment barriers.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, providing a streamlined setup for deploying your store. Stack 02, on the other hand, includes Cloudflare Pages and Workers along with Supabase, offering more advanced features and capabilities for a comprehensive e-commerce solution.

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting your digital product store. Each platform offers unique advantages, such as cost-effectiveness and ease of use, making them suitable for creators looking to establish their online presence.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for crypto transactions?

NOWPayments offers over 300 cryptocurrencies, low transaction fees of 0.5%, and no KYC requirements. This enables you to accept payments easily and securely, allowing customers to transact without needing an account, which enhances user experience.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01?

Deployment of Stack 01 typically takes between 4 to 6 hours when following the guidelines provided in the Sovereign Blueprint. This allows you to quickly set up your store and begin accepting payments.
